findings.issue: The Convergence Detection list says review's STOP is gated by "Three binary quality gates (evidence, scope, coverage)". The review stop path evaluates nine legal-stop gates before a candidate becomes STOP — convergenceGate, dimensionCoverageGate, p0ResolutionGate, evidenceDensityGate, hotspotSaturationGate, claimAdjudicationGate, fixCompletenessReplayGate, candidateCoverageGate, graphlessFallbackGate (convergence.cjs:1002-1014); any failed gate returns BLOCKED/blockedStop. The three gates the doc names are a different mechanism: terminal-gates.cjs records the evidence, scope and coverage rows at the terminal stop (terminal-gates.cjs:39-41), and a failing row makes the verdict FAIL (review-verdict.cjs:115), it does not prevent the stop.

evidence.cmd: rg -n "Three binary quality gates" .skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-review-presentation.txt; sed -n '1002,1014p' .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/convergence.cjs; sed -n '39,41p' .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/terminal-gates.cjs; sed -n '113,116p' .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/review-verdict.cjs
